#!/bin/bash

# Script to connect to an external server
# Usage: ./connect_server.sh [hostname] [port]

HOSTNAME=${1:-example.com}
PORT=${2:-22}

echo "Attempting to connect to $HOSTNAME on port $PORT..."

# Using telnet to test the connection, fallback to nc if not available
if command -v telnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "" | telnet "$HOSTNAME" "$PORT"
elif command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -vz "$HOSTNAME" "$PORT"
else
    echo "Error: Neither telnet nor netcat (nc) is available on this system."
    echo "Please install one of these tools to test connections."
    exit 1
fi

# Check the exit status
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Connection successful!"
else
    echo "Connection failed or timed out."
fi
